Amin.et: From English amine. By surface analysis, Am(moniak) + -in.

s: American (native or inhabitant of the USA)
Ami.et: Clipping of Amerikaner + -i. Appears to have entered the German language during the Second World War and the following occupation era, hence probably first used in reference to American soldiers.

Amiland.et: Compound of Ami (“Yank, American”) + Land (“land, country”).

s: member of a clique, profiteer of cronyism, corrupt politician (especially in Bavaria)
Schon nach dem Tod von Franz Josef Strauß 1987 und nach dem Rücktritt des Amigos Streibl 1993 wandten sich viele Wähler von der CSU ab.
After Franz Josef Strauß's death in 1987 as well as the resignation of his crony Streibl in 1993, many voters had already turned away from the CSU.
